📌 [...] people doing complex work across a lot of tools, especially people managing AI agents, projects, meetings, and communication at the same time. My request is simple: install Hansel, use it for one real workday, and ask what you did at the end of the day. If the answer doesn’t match your day, tell me what it missed. I’ll be here answering questions and learning from everyone who tries it! [...] Hey Product Hunt! I’m Ben, the founder and builder of Hansel. I built Hansel because my work is increasingly scattered across issues, browser tabs, email, chats, and meetings. Each place contains part of the story, but by the end of the day I can still struggle to answer a basic question: what did I actually do? Hansel creates a private history of that workday that I can ask questions about including “What did I do today?” Privacy was a product constraint from the beginning. By default, your activity history, chats, screenshots, and recordings are stored only on your Mac and are always encrypted. The encryption keys stay in your Mac’s Keychain. results.content: favor. Two decades in healthcare gave me the knowledge to advocate for myself, and a flexible job allowed me to sit on hold. I'd just started at Care Continuity , a company focused on patient navigation – the irony of which is not lost on me. Navigators are the glue that holds the care journey together, advocating and coordinating so patients don't have to do it alone. Almost two years later, I've lived the problem we solve every day. I joined because I believed in the work. I'm doubly invested now because I've lived it. My goal is to help patients who may not have healthcare expertise or a flexible job – because it doesn't matter how amazing the organization is, and UCSF is one of the best, if you can't get in the door to begin with. I completed active treatment in March and am [...] my story, I'm asked how I knew. Like many survivors, I felt a lump before any scan caught anything. This was July 2024. My wonderful PCP, Jerusalem at One Medical, referred me to UCSF Helen Diller Family Comprehensive Cancer Center "just in case" – and I'm grateful she didn't send me elsewhere. I got a mammogram on the calendar – four months out, despite the urgent referral. November was unacceptable to me. So I called every morning for a week. I waited on hold. I cried. Nothing shifted. The schedulers were kind, but it was out of their hands – the doctors manually reviewed urgent cases each morning. When they finally moved me up, I cried again – this time with relief. But the difference is that I had a few things working in my favor. Two decades in healthcare gave me the knowledge to [...] on the value and the business case. ## Hansel Surname Meaning

Dutch: from the personal name Hansel or Ansel, a pet form of Anselm (see Anselmo).

English: variant of Ansell with prosthetic H-.

German (also Hänsel): from a pet form of the personal name Hans.
